diagnostics.message: google_tags_tag_binding.binding resolves `tag_value` via `lookup(local.ctx.tag_values, each.value, each.value)`, so tag values created by this same module (google_tags_tag_value.default, e.g. referenced by namespaced name like "organizations/123/key/value") have no ordering relationship with the binding. The binding can be created before the tag value exists, and the TagBinding API will fail to resolve the value; an explicit depends_on on google_tags_tag_value.default is needed to guarantee the value (and transitively its key) is created first.
